info.description:
The course introduces vocabulary and topics around familiar topics such as fashion, architecture, society, education, economics, nature and human in the form of dialogues, newsletters, lectures...;
Learners are acquainted with pre-listening prediction skills based on available contexts, the ability to identify key messages and details during listening as well as attitudes, intonations, and implications of speakers in simple context as well as low-level notes and classifications;
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand the meaning of key words and simple phrases related to familiar topics
Apply different techniques flexibly so as to identify the structure of the listening texts , reason, predict information while listening.
Analyze the basic idea of the speeches related to simple, close themes that are presented slowly and clearly.
